description: Signature checks a port must agree with. Verify body and headers for the provider with secret (the webhook id for PayPal), publicKey (Discord), url and method, and a clock frozen at now (milliseconds); for PayPal, the certificate URL serves certificate. The result must equal expected. Header names match in any case. Only HubSpot limits the signature's age. Not verifiable: sendgrid (no signatures), plaid (needs Plaid's API).

vectors.name: mailgun, changed event data still verifies
adyen, changed field outside the signature still verifies
adyen, one unsigned item in a batch
twilio, repeated parameters sort by name, then value
hubspot, reserved characters in the URL are decoded before signing
standard-webhooks, a secret that is not base64 signs with its UTF-8 bytes, prefix included
stripe, any v1 signature in the header may match
stripe, a v0 signature is not checked
stripe, no age limit: a day-old signature verifies
github, header names match in any case
standard-webhooks, any signature in a space-separated list may match
hubspot, a signature older than five minutes
paypal, a certificate URL outside PayPal is refused
paypal, an algorithm other than SHA256withRSA is refused
